Description

If you're in Central Hill and need a tennis court, consider booking the one at Fidelis College. It's a sensational facility that's perfect whether you're playing a casual game with friends or you're part of a team or league. The court has a concrete surface.

You don't have to be a member to book the court; you can book on a pay as you play basis.

If you're driving, you'll be glad to know there's free parking available at the facility. Just be aware that spaces are limited, and the car park can get busy, especially on weekends.

For teams looking to secure a regular time slot, you can inquire about making a block booking. This typically involves booking the court for a set number of consecutive weeks, around 10 weeks on average, ensuring you have a guaranteed time to play every week.
